facts.fact: Jules 冷静下来后问 Bethany 要不要看更多他们的视频，说 “多亏 GlobalVill 那帮混蛋你们已经没法在网上看到它们”；Bethany 借口夜深告辞，离开 Turbo Putt 时还有点 stoned。
facts.anchor: “You can’t watch them online anymore thanks to those fuckers at GlobalVill,” they said. Bethany made an excuse about it being late at night. She left the Turbo Putt, still feeling a little stoned.

facts.fact: Bethany 真正难受的原因：那一切都是演的——Jules 的自杀未遂是假的，正如当初连 Douglas 在 Austin 都坚持的那样；这意味着她自 GlobalVill 最后那晚以来的所有行动都建立在错误假设上，而她给 Jules 报警反而差点毁了这个陌生人的生活，也就没有好理由留在 Lubbock。
facts.anchor: It had all been pretend. Jules’s suicide attempt had been a fake, just like Douglas, of all people, had insisted back in Austin. That meant Bethany’s actions since that final night at GlobalVill had been based on a false assumption.

facts.fact: 把车开进汽车旅馆停车场时，Bethany 出声对自己说 “No”：Jules 那晚在 GlobalVill 吞下一杯 Tic Tacs 时是真有麻烦、现在也仍有麻烦，她当晚做的和仍在做的帮忙之事有意义。
facts.anchor: Jules was in trouble. They had been in real, actual trouble that night back at GlobalVill when they chugged a cup of Tic Tacs, and they were still in trouble right now.

facts.fact: 回房后 Bethany 接受 Kyle 的深夜聊天提议，拨他手机却直接进了 voicemail；她想过留言又打消了——两人的友谊虽在一个月里变得亲密，还没到 “我有危机需要立刻谈” 的阶段。
facts.anchor: She dialed his cellphone. It went straight to voicemail. She thought about leaving a message, but decided against it.

facts.fact: 她又做了件近来很少做的事：打给妈妈。响了三声电话转入 voicemail，她留言 “Hi, Mom. It’s Bethany...” 试图让声音听起来正常、把惊慌的孤独藏起来；挂断后立刻后悔没向妈妈求救，主要是出于 ego。
facts.anchor: After three rings, Bethany’s call went to voicemail. She tried to sound normal in her message, to hide the panicked loneliness from her voice.

facts.fact: 她上一次回 Harlingen 是 Thanksgiving 2019：她带 Abel 见父母，然后让大家在客厅坐下来，直截了当告诉他们自己打算从今往后以女孩身份生活。
facts.anchor: not since Thanksgiving 2019 when she put herself through the psychic gauntlet of introducing her mom and dad to Abel and then sitting them all down in the living room to tell them point-blank she was planning to live as a girl from now on

facts.fact: 梦里她先被一群男人从童年卧室拖走（妈妈说 “They just want to help you remember your name”），接着场景变成 GlobalVill Austin 园区的电话亭兼医院病房兼她的 Pink Eye TV 摄影棚；窗外围观她的人形没有脸、没有身体、没有血肉——是静态（static）做成的。
facts.anchor: They were shaped like men, but they weren’t men at all. They didn’t have faces or bodies or flesh. They were made of static.

facts.fact: Bethany 从床上惊醒（身体在振动，The Wolves of Birmingham 已播完、电视改放 Jason Statham 动作片），发现自己不再独自在房间——梦里那个 static man 之一正站在她床边，直直盯着她。
facts.anchor: One of the static men from her dream was here with her now, standing at the edge of her bed, staring right at her.
